title: Enterprise AI Copilot public README bootstrap
refined_problem: After the repository was cleaned to harness-only infrastructure, the root README still documents the agent harness instead of the new product. The repository needs a public, English, product-first README for Enterprise AI Copilot, while the existing harness operator documentation must be preserved under docs/ without losing its instructions.

original_request.text: quiero limpiar todo repositorio ... (proyecto nuevo) ... Ahora lo elimino pero mientras creame el readme del proyecto ... ya agregaste el readme?

target_users: Collaborating engineers on the new repository
outcomes: Repository root communicates the Enterprise AI Copilot product clearly in English
Harness operator documentation remains discoverable under docs/
success_metrics: README.md renders with all agreed sections and no broken relative links
docs/HARNESS.md preserves the previous operator content with corrected links

in: Replace root README.md with the approved English product README
Move previous harness README content to docs/HARNESS.md with adjusted relative links
out: Product code, tasks beyond this documentation change

mvp.goal: A publication-quality README that establishes the product identity and preserves harness documentation.
includes: Target AWS architecture table marked as proposed, not implemented
Differentiators: multi-tenant security, verifiable answers, controlled actions, evaluation, observability

success_metrics_note: Single bounded documentation outcome; verified by content checks and link integrity.
assumptions: Product name is Enterprise AI Copilot as decided by the user
README language is English as decided by the user
Positioning is product-first, without learning-program framing
challenges: Relative links inside docs/HARNESS.md must be corrected for the new location

tasks.title: Write Enterprise AI Copilot product README and relocate harness README
tasks.description: Replace the root README.md with the approved English product-first README for Enterprise AI Copilot. Preserve the previous root README (Portable Agent Engineering Harness operator documentation) as docs/HARNESS.md, correcting internal relative links for the new location. No mention of the learning program or roadmaps; architecture marked as proposed.
acceptance_criteria: Root README.md contains sections: title, overview, Example, Target architecture (AWS), Differentiators, Development
Target architecture is explicitly marked as proposed and not yet implemented
Differentiators cover multi-tenant security, verifiable answers with citations and abstention, controlled actions with confirmation, automatic evaluation, observability and cost control
No reference to a learning program, 90-day roadmap, or portfolio deliverables exists in README.md
The previous README operator content exists at docs/HARNESS.md with relative links corrected
All relative Markdown links in README.md and docs/HARNESS.md resolve
No secrets, tokens or confidential data in either file

research_rdd.reason: Bounded documentation change with no domain, external-contract or architecture unknowns.

recorded_decisions: cleanup of tasks/planning/specs/sprints/benchmarks/evals and .harness/overlays confirmed and executed by owner
